title: Warming Showcase Category, HSN and GST
intro: Nine live listings in the KitchenaryKart Warming Showcase category — two-layer and three-layer cabinets in black and red, curved, straight and slanting fronts, and four numbered countertop models — with the website category, HSN code and GST rate recorded against each SKU.

link.text: Warming Showcase category reviewed on 23 September 2026

notes: GST: every SKU in this category is recorded at 18%.

HSN: every SKU is recorded at 84198190 — machinery for the treatment of materials by a change of temperature. A warming showcase holds prepared food at serving temperature, so the heading fits and the category is internally consistent.

KKHE0282-BWS2LCM, KKHE0285-RWS3LCMB are variant rows rather than products of their own: the curved 2-layer is a variant of KKHE0281-BWS2LSM and the big 3-layer red is a variant of KKHE0284-RWS3LCMS. They inherit the parent listing’s HSN and GST, and are listed here so the document covers all nine.

KKHE0285-RWS3LCMB (big) currently shows the same dimensions as its parent KKHE0284-RWS3LCMS (small) — 49 x 39 x 54 cm on both. Those cannot both be right; the big model’s own measurements are still needed. This does not affect HSN or GST.
Six of the nine are out of stock on the website at the time of writing. Stock does not affect HSN or GST; noted only so this list is not mistaken for an availability report.
